verdict.rationale: Financial Connections is a permissioned bank-data API (balances, ownership, transactions), so an AI-insights story is a fair question for it, but nothing shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions. The 'Financial insights for agents / agent-powered spending analysis' use case relies on the user's own external agent analyzing data pulled through the Link CLI. Likewise, the Stripe MCP server only gives agents API access. Both are developer building blocks rather than built-in AI insights.
